changelog:
Gradient Background now works: the appearance page exposes the gradient switch and the preset picker, and the stored preset paints a dark gradient behind app content through the same reversible visual lease as the theme colours.
Picking a preset writes its start and end colour; an unreadable preset is never guessed at and leaves the background untouched, and turning the option off restores the host background exactly.
Unused, unreferenced plugin code was removed (compiler- and suite-verified): theme/feature statistics helpers, manager leftovers and unreachable animation, toolbar, scroll and utility helpers no longer ship.
message: Dev build v856 - Working gradient background and a slimmer plugin
